Team,

This is the weekly turn-in reminder for forecast submissions (EOD Monday 10/05). Attached is the Q4 forecast template and an evidence checklist. Please complete the template and link any supporting docs in the Drive folder prior to the call.

Monday call (10/05) 10:00–10:30 PT — Zoom (invite on calendar)
Call focus: confirm commit lanes, validate evidence for finance handoff, and surface any procurement timing risks.

Call agenda (tight):
- 10:00  Roll call & commit snapshot (each owner 45s)
- 10:08  Risk bucket quickfires (Marissa)
- 10:14  Evidence acceptability pass (Marcus)
- 10:22  Finance/procurement flags & next steps (Priyom + cc'd procurement)
- 10:28  Action items & owner assignments

Action items before the call:
1) Update HubSpot stage and expected close date for any change in status.
2) Upload final SOW/PO/attestations to Drive and paste links in the evidence checklist.
3) Flag any deals that need payment-term discussions (Acme is cc'd here).

Acme procurement  thank you for being available. We'll call out HS-8743 timing on the call.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4_forecast_template.xlsx, evidence_checklist.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bForecastDocs
